figures.name: Orpheus

ability.name: Song That Moves All Things
ability.description: Charm all enemies for 1 turn; even non-charmable enemies are stunned.

figures.description: Greatest musician who ever lived whose singing moved stones, charmed beasts and almost rescued the dead.

figures.name: Sabazios

ability.name: Sky Rider
ability.description: Deal 5 thunder damage; all enemies are confused for 1 turn from divine ecstasy.

figures.description: Thracian sky horseman god of thunder and ecstatic religion who rides across the heavens on his white horse.

figures.name: Bendis

ability.name: Twin Torches
ability.description: Illuminate the field and deal 4 fire damage to all dark-alignment enemies.

figures.description: Two-spear-bearing moon goddess whose nocturnal torch procession was one of Athens's most beloved festivals.

figures.name: Zalmoxis

ability.name: Immortality Teaching
ability.description: One ally per battle cannot be permanently destroyed; they return at 1 HP instead.

figures.description: Mysterious divine figure who retreated to an underground chamber for three years and returned, teaching immortality.

figures.name: Kotys

ability.name: Night Rite
ability.description: All enemies lose 2 wisdom; your dark abilities deal +2 bonus damage for 1 turn.

figures.description: Wild goddess of ecstatic nocturnal rites whose ceremonies involved frenzied masked dancing in the mountains.

figures.name: The Rider Hero

ability.name: Sacred Horseman
ability.description: Gain +3 speed and deal 4 damage with a lance strike that ignores defense.

figures.description: The anonymous divine horseman depicted on thousands of Thracian votive reliefs, patron of warriors and the dead.

figures.name: Pleistoros

ability.name: Blood Offering
ability.description: Sacrifice 2 of this card's HP to deal 7 damage to one enemy.

figures.description: Savage war god honored with human sacrifice on the banks of Thracian rivers.

figures.name: Hestiaea

ability.name: River's Bounty
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies; nature enemies lose 1 power.

figures.description: Earth and river goddess of Thrace who presided over fertility of the land and all flowing waters.

figures.name: Dionysos of Thrace

ability.name: Thracian Frenzy
ability.description: Inflict berserk on all enemies: they gain +3 power but attack randomly for 1 turn.

figures.description: The original wild Thracian Dionysos from whom the Greek Dionysus derived, god of intoxication and liberation.

figures.name: Maenads

ability.name: Sparagmos
ability.description: Deal 3 damage to all enemies; enemies with the highest defense lose 2 defense.

figures.description: Frenzied female devotees of Dionysos who tore wild animals and enemies apart with their bare hands.

figures.name: Eurydice

ability.name: Shadow Love
ability.description: When this card is destroyed, grant all allies +3 magic from grief and inspiration.

figures.description: Orpheus's wife whose death in the grass drove him to the underworld and whose second death broke the world.

figures.name: Ares of Thrace

ability.name: Thracian Bloodlust
ability.description: This card deals +3 bonus damage while any ally is below half HP.

figures.description: The Thracian form of Ares who was worshipped with greater devotion here than anywhere else in the ancient world.

figures.name: Thrax

ability.name: Ancestor's Strength
ability.description: When played, all Thracian-culture allies gain +1 to all stats.

figures.description: Legendary founder of the Thracian people, son of Ares and the Oceanid Kritobule.

figures.name: Thracian Horseman Spirit

ability.name: Road of the Hero
ability.description: Prevent one enemy from changing position or using flanking abilities.

figures.description: The anonymous divine horseman spirit who appears on boundary stones across Thrace protecting travelers.

figures.name: Tereus

ability.name: Hoopoe's Cry
ability.description: Inflict a lasting debuff on one enemy that prevents them from using voice/song abilities.

figures.description: Tragic king of Thrace transformed into the hoopoe bird after a cycle of violence and revenge.

figures.name: Lykourgos

ability.name: Divine Punishment
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to any chaos-aligned card; this card then suffers 2 backlash damage.

figures.description: Thracian king who defied Dionysos, was driven mad and killed his own son before being torn apart.

figures.name: Sparti (Sown Warriors)

ability.name: Dragon Sowing
ability.description: Summon two 4/4/4/4/4 warrior tokens for 2 turns.

figures.description: Warriors born from dragon's teeth sown in the earth, brothers-in-arms until they destroy each other.

figures.name: Kotys's Servant

ability.name: Masked Rite
ability.description: This card's identity is hidden; enemy cannot use targeted abilities against it for 1 turn.

figures.description: Masked servant of the goddess Kotys who leads the nocturnal mountain processions.

figures.name: Thracian Shaman

ability.name: Trance Walk
ability.description: Look at all face-down enemy cards; choose one to activate immediately.

figures.description: Thracian spirit-traveler who uses ecstatic trance to journey between the world of the living and the dead.

figures.name: Polydorus

ability.name: Restless Ghost
ability.description: Deal 2 damage per turn to the enemy who holds the most buffs.

figures.description: Trojan prince whose murder by the treacherous Thracian king Polymestor is avenged by his mother Hecuba.
